title: GEMSDOE69 — auditable fault-discovery workbench
description: Auditable DOE GEMS fault-discovery workbench whose method lane is the catalogue-geometry relay-ramp / pull-apart / displacement-transfer corridor approach: build a graph from catalogue fault polylines, rank corridors (not isolated pixels) on multi-scale gravity, magnetic and lidar-scarp evidence, and treat the geological prior as a proposal for where to inspect rather than an assertion that a fault exists. Its README's current release decision is “NEGATIVE / NOT READY”: there is no submission GeoTIFF in the repository, data-dependent holdout, leakage, uniqueness and template validation cannot be completed, and no competition slot has been used. The configured Pages root serves a static status site (index.html plus submission guide, hypotheses and sources pages). The directory repeats the repository's own wording and makes no independent claim.
